site.name: Sky Map
site.title: Sky Map — The Universe in your Pocket
site.description: Hold your phone up and Sky Map shows you the stars, planets and constellations overhead. Free and open source since 2009.
hero.lede: Hold your phone toward the sky and Sky Map shows you what's there: constellations, planets and deep-sky objects, with an info card for each.
help.contact.title: Need help?
help.contact.include: Please tell us your device, Android or iOS version, and Sky Map version, and what you expected to happen.

page.history.title: A short history of Sky Map
feat.title: Point. Find. Learn.
feat.search.d: Search by name, designation or coordinates, then follow the arrow on screen until the target is centred.
feat.info.d: Tap an object for a photo, a description, key facts and when it rises and sets where you are.
feat.time.d: Run the sky forward or back, from the year 1600 to 3000, or jump to the next sunset, full moon or eclipse.
feat.night.d: A red-shifted display that keeps your eyes dark-adapted at the eyepiece or in the field.
v2.title: Rebuilt from the ground up
v2.lede: Sky Map 2 is a new app with a new sky renderer, the same free price, and fewer rough edges.
v2.1.t: Rise and set times on every card
v2.1.d: Planet, star or galaxy: see when it next rises and sets where you are, and whether it never sets at all.
v2.2.d: Right ascension and declination, altitude and azimuth, and the field of view, live on the map.
v2.3.t: Tap to identify, out of the box
v2.3.d: Tap any labelled object for its card. It was switched off by default in v1.
v2.4.d: The Sun and Moon are computed far more precisely, so an eclipse peaks when it actually does.
v2.5.d: Zoom in and watch them wax and wane, instead of flat, fully lit dots.
story.title: Still free. Still independent.
story.d: Sky Map began in 2009, was open-sourced in 2012, and relaunched as version 2 in 2026. It is maintained as a passion project by those who created it, with no ads, no account, and analytics you can switch off.
support.d: If Sky Map is useful to you, you can help keep it going.
